name: Bstrlib (The Better String Library)
listed_description: Alternative to NUL-terminated C strings, recommended by the book as stable and well-tested for production use; length-tracked bstring type with a C++ wrapper.
claim_text: Book says C string length needs a full traversal, often repeated, a performance penalty; bstrlib offered as alternative. No speed numbers.
guessed_baseline: C standard library string.h functions (strlen/strcpy/strcat); std::string for the C++ wrapper
found_in: book: Learn C Programming, 2nd ed. (2024), p. unknown (PDF chunk 3), ch. 15 Working with Strings, section Weaknesses of C strings
